description: This file defines the ManageController class, which handles user account management features such as profile viewing/updating, password management, external login linking, and two-factor authentication setup within an ASP.NET Core MVC web application. It includes various actions for user profile operations, OTP setup, and external login management.

classes.name: ManageController
classes.description: Controller managing user profile, password, external login, and 2FA operations.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles GET request to view user account details and POST request to update user profile (email, phone).

methods.name: SendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Generates email confirmation token and sends verification email to user.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Handles GET request to display change password page and POST request to change password.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Displays set password page if user has no password and handles POST to set a new password.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays linked external logins and available providers.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Initiates linking an external login provider.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Handles external login info callback to link external login.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes linked external login.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Displays 2FA status and recovery codes.

methods.name: Disable2faWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before disabling 2FA.

methods.name: Disable2fa
methods.description: Disables 2FA for the user.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Prepares model to enable authenticator app, loads shared key and QR URI.

methods.name: ShowRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Displays recovery codes to the user.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Handles POST request to verify OTP and enable 2FA, generates recovery codes.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticatorWarning
methods.description: Displays warning to reset authenticator app.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticator
methods.description: Resets authenticator key and disables 2FA.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Generates new 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodesWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before generating new recovery codes.

methods.name: AddErrors
methods.description: Adds IdentityResult errors to ModelState.

methods.name: FormatKey
methods.description: Formats authenticator key for display.

methods.name: GenerateQrCodeUri
methods.description: Generates URI for QR code based on user email and key.

methods.name: LoadSharedKeyAndQrCodeUriAsync
methods.description: Loads authenticator key and QR code URI into the model.
